question: Who launched the Mukhya Mantrir Jiban Anuprerana Scheme in June 2025?

options.text: Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma

solution:
The correct answer is __**Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Mukhya Mantrir Jiban Anuprerana Scheme** was officially launched by the **Chief Minister of Assam**, **Himanta Biswa Sarma**, in **June 2025**.
 
• This initiative is designed to provide **socio-economic support** and inspiration to the citizens of the state, focusing on enhancing the quality of life through **government-led interventions**.
 
• The launch event took place in **Assam**, emphasizing the state's vision for **holistic development** and the empowerment of its residents across various districts.
 
• Under the leadership of **Himanta Biswa Sarma**, the scheme aims to bridge the gap between **administrative policies** and the **grassroots needs** of the people.
